item.title: Here's how to recycle those old laptops, iPhones and earbuds lying around
item.description: Most consumers are guilty of the same habit — filling drawers or closets with devices such as old laptops, cellphones, fitness trackers and other electronics once those things are no longer needed. It’s hard to know where to take these items for recycling, or it’s seemingly costly and inconvenient to do so. item.title: Oklahoma’s governor picks energy executive Alan Armstrong to fill US Senate seat through end of year
item.description: Oklahoma’s governor has appointed energy executive Alan Armstrong to fill a newly vacant U.S. Senate seat through the end of the year. The announcement Tuesday came after former Oklahoma Sen. Markwayne Mullin was confirmed as the Trump administration’s new homeland security secretary. Armstrong is the chairman and former CEO of Williams Companies, a major pipeline operator based in Tulsa. He’s a longtime supporter of Oklahoma Gov. Kevin Stitt and won’t be in the job long. item.title: Northern Lights Foundation honors Duluth East graduate with legacy grant
item.description: The Northern Lights Foundation announced the new Shimia Nord Legacy Grant, an annual $5,000 grant to honor the life and inspirational spirit of Shimia Nord, a Duluth East High School graduated who died of cancer in September 2025 at the age of 18.
